# Red Graphite

Red Graphite is a minimal colour theme with light and dark variants whose look is taken from Bear.app. Default note rendering is left in place while the surrounding UI is restyled, and base and accent colours can be adjusted through Style Settings.

![Red Graphite screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanwcom/Red-Graphite-for-Obsidian/HEAD/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Red Graphite"
    author: "seanwcom"
    repo:   "seanwcom/Red-Graphite-for-Obsidian"
    slug:   "red-graphite"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/red-graphite"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/seanwcom/Red-Graphite-for-Obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanwcom/Red-Graphite-for-Obsidian/HEAD/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a minimal Red Graphite color theme with light and dark variants inspired by Bear.app. Preserve default note rendering while restyling the UI, and tweak base and accent colors via Style Settings for a custom palette."
}
```
